Nzeke Peace Agbanya first of all it's not "to pay". It's not a payment, it's a deposit that will be returned if you abide by the law.
You can withdraw the appeal, sure. To get a time extension for the payment you can reach out to them and explain that on the 10th you will have the money. You can also reach out to them about the appeal and check what its status is...
